annotations.title: What we've learned about a workflow

description: Newest first: steps added to or dropped from the diagram (and by whom), and claims about who does what or what a step takes — said, corrected (with what they replaced), withdrawn, or accepted from a proposal — each with its source. This is when we LEARNED things; when they were true is each claim's validFrom/validTo. Use it to brief someone on what changed in the picture, or to see what an interview added.

since.description: Only what was learned on or after this date.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.
